description: Developer-authored evaluation. Original UCI cases became regressions after first run. TPC-H cases are first-run holdouts until executed. No expected results enter model prompts.

cases.question: From 1993 to 1994, how did the number of orders change in absolute and percentage terms?
cases.oracle_sql: WITH v AS (SELECT COUNT_IF(YEAR(O_ORDERDATE)=1994) AS target_value, COUNT_IF(YEAR(O_ORDERDATE)=1993) AS reference_value FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.ORDERS) SELECT target_value,reference_value,target_value-reference_value AS difference,100.0*(target_value-reference_value)/NULLIF(reference_value,0) AS percent_change FROM v

cases.question: For customers in France, compare average order value in 1996 against 1994, including the percentage change relative to 1994.
cases.oracle_sql: WITH v AS (SELECT AVG(IFF(YEAR(o.O_ORDERDATE)=1996,o.O_TOTALPRICE,NULL)) AS target_value,AVG(IFF(YEAR(o.O_ORDERDATE)=1994,o.O_TOTALPRICE,NULL)) AS reference_value FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.ORDERS o JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.CUSTOMER c ON o.O_CUSTKEY=c.C_CUSTKEY JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.NATION n ON c.C_NATIONKEY=n.N_NATIONKEY WHERE n.N_NAME='FRANCE') SELECT target_value,reference_value,target_value-reference_value AS difference,100.0*(target_value-reference_value)/NULLIF(reference_value,0) AS percent_change FROM v

cases.question: In 1996, what percentage of all orders came from customers in Germany?
cases.oracle_sql: WITH v AS (SELECT COUNT_IF(n.N_NAME='GERMANY') AS target_value,COUNT(*) AS reference_value FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.ORDERS o JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.CUSTOMER c ON o.O_CUSTKEY=c.C_CUSTKEY JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.NATION n ON c.C_NATIONKEY=n.N_NATIONKEY WHERE YEAR(o.O_ORDERDATE)=1996) SELECT target_value,reference_value,100.0*target_value/NULLIF(reference_value,0) AS share_percent FROM v

cases.question: During 1994, list all customer nations whose average order value was above the overall average order value for that year.
cases.oracle_sql: WITH scope AS (SELECT o.O_TOTALPRICE,n.N_NAME AS nation FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.ORDERS o JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.CUSTOMER c ON o.O_CUSTKEY=c.C_CUSTKEY JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.NATION n ON c.C_NATIONKEY=n.N_NATIONKEY WHERE YEAR(o.O_ORDERDATE)=1994),g AS (SELECT nation,AVG(O_TOTALPRICE) AS average_order_value FROM scope GROUP BY nation),p AS (SELECT AVG(O_TOTALPRICE) AS overall_average FROM scope) SELECT nation,average_order_value,overall_average,average_order_value-overall_average AS difference FROM g CROSS JOIN p WHERE average_order_value>overall_average

cases.question: For the BUILDING customer segment in 1997, give both the order count and distinct customers with orders.
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count,COUNT(DISTINCT o.O_CUSTKEY) AS customer_count FROM SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.ORDERS o JOIN SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.TPCH_SF1.CUSTOMER c ON o.O_CUSTKEY=c.C_CUSTKEY WHERE c.C_MKTSEGMENT='BUILDING' AND YEAR(o.O_ORDERDATE)=1997
